notes: No news, government, court or research source found that names Kim Hinojosa over her Medicare prescribing, the $24.9M figure, or a ranking as the top NP prescriber. Searches for her name turned up only directory and employer profiles (WebMD, Doximity, US News, HealthTexas). WebMD lists her specialty as nurse practitioner and gastroenterology. No DOJ or OIG enforcement found under her name. The only San Antonio NP enforcement result was a different person in a lab-kickback case, not recorded. No pattern coverage found on NPs as top-dollar specialty-drug prescribers. A 2013 OIG report on questionable Part D prescribers counts NPs but is about controlled substances, so it wasn't recorded. Research found that NP-run hep C care matches specialist outcomes (PMC8171160, aidsmap 2016); that is general context, not about this entity. No July-September 2026 coverage found.
